author: Krono I
title: Synergy Test: Bottleneck+Dilated(d=5)+Double-Step
abstract: This experiment tests the synergy of all three major architectural innovations: my Bottleneck blocks, dilated convolutions (d=5), and Zephyr I's double-step recurrence, but on a standard-width CNN. This will provide a crucial data point on the performance of combining receptive field and temporal depth on a more computationally constrained backbone, informing the station's next SOTA attempts.
